title: AI - Absent Intelligence
altText: Biomorphic cyberpunk graffiti mural by Mr Blob at Overline Jam themed on AI, showing a mechanical brain splitting open to release a vibrant surreal creature with a giant eye, representing human imagination.
description:
Created for the historic Overline Jam and centered around the theme of Artificial Intelligence, this site-specific mural acts as a powerful social critique. The artwork directly addresses the urgent need to disconnect from digital devices, breaking free from technological constraints to unlock and nurture raw human imagination and thought.

The dynamic composition illustrates a human mask splitting in two, with the face being sucked into a smartphone. Emerging from within, like an explosion of vital energy and fluorescent flows, is a striking bio-organic tentacled creature dominated by a massive psychedelic eye. The sharp chromatic contrast between the cold outer shell and the vibrant neon energy (yellow, purple, and cyan) breaking out symbolizes the act of rebellion against digital conformity. Executed entirely freehand with professional spray paint against a saturated turquoise background, the piece stands out for its master-level control of light emissions (glow-effects) and its acute urban storytelling.
